integrity: Analytical derivation supported by embedded deterministic quadrature and seeded stochastic checker; no independent validation claimed.
scientific_limitations: Fixed real two-column deterministic bases independent of iid Gaussian sketch; 1<tau<kappa and large-row asymptotic at fixed thresholds. Does not establish adaptive Krylov restart failure probabilities, other sketch families, numerical stability or floating-point performance; open bibliographic overlap risk with general Wishart condition-number laws.
title: Sharp false-acceptance asymptotics for Gaussian two-column sketch conditioning
